title: AutoLayoutRequest
description: Body of POST /api/dashboards/:id/auto-layout (HEL-367) — packs the supplied panel sizes into non-overlapping {x,y,w,h} positions (left-to-right shelf-flow, input order = visual order) and persists them identically to all four responsive breakpoints. `cols` is optional and defaults to 12. Panels on the dashboard but omitted from `items` keep their current saved position; a `panelId` not belonging to the target dashboard rejects the whole request with 400.

cols.description: Grid column count to pack against. Defaults to 12 (the desktop lg breakpoint's column count) when omitted.
